patches.value: Let f1,f2,f3 be any three paths of finite X norm on I. For each path decompose frequencies at N/3. If all three input frequencies have modulus <=N/3, their sum has modulus <=N, so that cubic contribution vanishes after P_(>N). Multilinearity writes the remaining contribution as the sum of Cint(P_(>N/3)f1,f2,f3), Cint(P_(<=N/3)f1,P_(>N/3)f2,f3), and Cint(P_(<=N/3)f1,P_(<=N/3)f2,P_(>N/3)f3). Fourier projections contract L2 and the derivative H^(-23/14) norm. Each designated high input has H^(-23/14) norm <=C N^(-23/14) times its L2 norm. N006 therefore bounds this sum by C*h*product_j||f_j||_X+C*N^(-23/14)*product_j||f_j||_(L^infty L2), putting the negative norm on the designated high input in each summand. Instantiate this inequality for (e,g,V) and (v,v,e), where g=v-e/2. F001 gives ||e||_X<=C_M(tau^gamma+E_I), the other X norms <=C_M, and their L2 products <=C_M E_I. Consequently the two projected cubic integrals have total norm <=C_M*h*tau^gamma+C_M*(h+N^(-23/14))*E_I.
